segments.name: Cost management
segments.description: Provides data analytics and technology-enabled cost management, payment and revenue integrity solutions to healthcare payers and the employers and members they serve.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its operations as a single segment for the purposes of assessing performance and making decisions.

revenueModel.text: Payers, including administrative services only platforms and third-party administrators, pay for claims intelligence, network, payment integrity and data and analytics solutions delivered to employers and members.
revenueModel.evidence: Although our direct clients are typically payers, including administrative services only platforms ("ASO") and third-party administrators ("TPA"), the end beneficiaries of our solutions include employers and other plan sponsors and the health plan members and patients they serve.
